**Issue #2929 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2929: Patch: the AI's search expects its own quiz answers as it will really give them, so it casts KY's Competition
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

KY's Competition asks its caster a run of arithmetic questions. Each right answer grows a Lil' Kenny, which is summoned when the run ends; a wrong answer or Stop ends the run. When the practice AI actually plays the card, it answers these well (85% right) and never stops early.

While it is planning, though, it imagines taking whatever answer looks best right away, and that means stopping at once for a tiny Kenny. So it thinks the card is worth almost nothing and never plays it: zero times in 118 Hard turns where it could afford it. KY's Test has a related blind spot: the AI guesses questions it could work out.

Once this is built, the AI's planning expects the answers it will really give, so it plays these cards when they are good.

## Why

- **The search takes the best immediate answer.** In a simulated line, the AI's own prompts are answered by `best_auto_answer` (`crates/ai/src/simulate.rs:394` on), which picks the answer with the best immediate evaluation. It is reached through `own_prompt_score` (line 450).
- **For KY's Competition, the best immediate answer is to stop.** A right answer only opens the next question, while Stop or a miss summons Lil' Kenny at once (`crates/engine/src/subsystems/ky_competition.rs`, the graded hook). So the search values the play at about a 1/1.
- **The real decision answers differently.**
  - It uses `worked_answer_action` (`crates/ai/src/decide.rs:78-100`), which works the answer out from the shown statement.
  - It is right `AI_KY_COMPETITION_ACCURACY = 0.85` of the time (`crates/ai/src/config.rs:22`).
  - It never stops, up to `KY_COMPETITION_MAX = 30` (`crates/engine/src/config.rs:767`).
- **KY's Test is guessed.** `worked_answer_action` takes only Answer prompts that carry a streak (`decide.rs:85`). KY's Test (C+ #42) has none, so its Easy problem `a op b = ?` (`crates/engine/src/subsystems/ky_test.rs:91`) is guessed although `worked_answer` can parse it.
- **The sweep shows it.** KY's Competition (M+ #20) was played 0 times in 118 affordable Hard turns and 3 times in 115 Easy ones (`training/history/sweep-2026-10-29-4.md:216-217`).

## Proposal

1. When the seat's own open prompt is one `worked_answer_action` would answer, the simulation answers it the same way. It answers right for the expected streak at `AI_KY_COMPETITION_ACCURACY` (a named constant derived in `crates/ai/src/config.rs`), then ends the run. It does not take the best immediate answer.
2. Let `worked_answer_action` also take an Answer prompt without a streak whose statement `worked_answer` parses (KY's Test's Easy problem). It is right at a named accuracy and still never reads the key (R465).
3. Every other prompt keeps `best_auto_answer`.

## Where it lands

- `crates/ai/src/simulate.rs`, `crates/ai/src/decide.rs` and `crates/ai/src/config.rs`.
- Position tests in `crates/ai`, in the style of the Trigor test from #2451.
- R465 and R1563005. No new ruling.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] With KY's Competition in hand, the mana to cast it and no better play, the AI casts it.
- [ ] With KY's Test, on a seed where the right option is not listed first, the AI answers the Easy problem correctly and never reads the key.
- [ ] The simulated value of casting KY's Competition is at least that of summoning a Lil' Kenny of the expected streak's size.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai` passes and `cargo jackioh gate` holds its floors.

## Size and risks

Small to medium: one special case in the simulation's own-prompt answer, a widened guard, and two position tests. The risk is the simulation answering a prompt better than the real decision will, which would overvalue the cards; using the same accuracy and the same streak rule as the real decision guards against it. Rerun `cargo jackioh sweep` for M+ #20 and C+ #42 to confirm.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41649078100)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

The AI's search values KY's Competition (M+ #20) at the Kenny its real decision will actually earn, and its real decision works out KY's Test (C+ #42) Easy problems instead of guessing. Done when `decide` casts the Competition with mana and no better play, answers a Test Easy problem right without reading the key, the simulated cast is worth a Kenny of the expected streak, and the AI crate's tests plus `spec check` pass. No new ruling: behavior cites R465 and R1563005 only.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | Add `AI_KY_COMPETITION_EXPECTED_STREAK: i32 = 6`, `AI_KY_COMPETITION_RADIANT_EXPECTED_STREAK: i32 = 12` beside the accuracy constants |
| `crates/ai/src/decide.rs` | change | `worked_answer_action`: drop the `streak.is_none()` rejection so any `Answer` prompt whose statement `worked_answer` parses is taken; update its doc comment |
| `crates/ai/src/simulate.rs` | change | Add `worked_sim_answer` + `step_single_answer`; `own_prompt_score` tries them first on the seat's own prompt |
| `crates/ai/src/search.rs` | change | `score_line`'s #1636 own-prompt branch tries the worked path first |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/ky_competition.rs` | change | Three tests: casts it, simulated value matches expected Kenny, sim ignores the key |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/answer_key.rs` | change | One test: Test Easy answered right, key never read |
| `crates/ai/README.md` | change | Two short paragraph updates (sequence-question answering, `best_auto_answer` scope) |

Must not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `crates/engine/`, `crates/cards/`, `apps/web/`, anything under `spec/` (no new ruling, and both test files are already in R465's / R1563005's `proven_in`), `crates/ai/src/reply.rs` (opponent-turn prompts keep `best_auto_answer` per proposal step 3). Governing notes: `spec/rulings/R0465.md`, `spec/rulings/R1563005.md`, SPEC §8.7 row 42, §8.9 row 20, §9.9.

## Steps

1. `crates/ai/src/config.rs`: after `AI_KY_COMPETITION_RADIANT_ACCURACY`, add the two streak constants with values `6` (base) and `12` (Radiant). Comment each as the hard-coded expectation of its accuracy: E = p(1−p^30)/(1−p) is ~5.6 at 0.85 and ~11.8 at 0.93, rounded, per the maintainer's hard-code steer on the issue; both below `KY_COMPETITION_MAX` (30). Copy the doc style of the accuracy constants (ruling id, faces, stream note: the sim draws nothing, so it stays deterministic).
2. `crates/ai/src/decide.rs`, `worked_answer_action`: replace the guard `pending.player_id != seat || pending.kind != PromptKind::Answer || pending.streak.is_none()` with `pending.player_id != seat || pending.kind != PromptKind::Answer`, so a streakless `Answer` prompt whose statement parses (Test Easy) is taken and anything unparseable (Test Medium/Hard bank, Last Exam, garbled) still returns `None`. Leave the body untouched: label lookup, accuracy by `pending.resume.radiant` (Test Easy reuses the Competition accuracies — same worked-arithmetic skill, no new tuning surface), wrong-pick excluding `ANSWER_STOP_KEY`, never Stop. Update the doc comment to name C+ #42 Easy alongside M+ #20, keeping the R465/R1563005 cites.
3. `crates/ai/src/simulate.rs`: add `pub(crate) fn worked_sim_answer(state: &GameState, seat: PlayerId) -> Option<ActionBody>`. Return `None` unless the pending prompt belongs to `seat`, has `kind == PromptKind::Answer`, and `worked_answer(&pending.prompt)` parses. Find the option whose `label` equals the worked value; if none, `None`. If `streak` is `Some(s)`, return the right-answer body while `s` is below the face's expected constant (`pending.resume.radiant` selects it, same expression as `decide.rs`), else return `stop_answer(state)`. If `streak` is `None`, return the right-answer body. Import `worked_answer`, `stop_answer`, `ANSWER_KEY`, `PromptKind` from `jackioh_engine`, and the two new constants from `crate::config`.
4. `crates/ai/src/simulate.rs`: add `fn step_single_answer(state, seat, body, counter, prefix, prices) -> Option<SimStep>` that steps exactly one fixed answer: `counter.take()` (else `None`), `reduce_unpiloted` under `catch_unwind` (panic → `note_sim_panic`, returned as `Some(Err)`), engine error → `note_sim_error` + `Some(Err)`, then `charge_announced`. Mirror `best_auto_answer`'s lines for these four operations exactly.
5. `crates/ai/src/simulate.rs`, `own_prompt_score`: split the loop into a `worked` counter (cap `KY_COMPETITION_MAX`) and an `answered` counter (cap `max_auto_answers`). Each iteration, when the holder is `seat` and `worked_sim_answer` returns `Some(body)`: clone the state, overwrite `pending.resume.data[ANSWER_KEY]` with the answer's letter taken from its own `Selection::Mode{option}` (never call `answer_key_of` — the true key is never read, so twin states differing only in it simulate alike; the Stop body needs no key), step with `step_single_answer` under prefix `"ahead"`, increment `worked`, continue. Otherwise run the existing `best_auto_answer` path and increment `answered`. Rationale for the re-key, stated in one comment line: `answered_correctly` is false with no key, so without it every simulated right answer would grade wrong and end the run.
6. `crates/ai/src/search.rs`, `score_line` #1636 branch: same priority. When the pending prompt belongs to `seat`, try `worked_sim_answer` first (re-key the clone from its own selection exactly as in step 5, step with the equivalent single-answer call, bounded by a local `worked` counter capped at `KY_COMPETITION_MAX`); on `None` keep the existing `best_auto_answer` call and `answered` cap. Keep the `at += 1` on `Answer` behavior unchanged.
7. `crates/ai/README.md`: extend the sequence-question paragraph (it answers M+ #20 and C+ #42 Easy at once, never Stop, never the key) and the Budgets paragraph (the beam's look past the seat's own prompt and `score_line` replays answer worked prompts at their hard-coded expected streak, everything else keeps `best_auto_answer`). Two short edits, no restructuring.
8. Verify the widened guard takes nothing unintended: run a scratch probe (under `/tmp`, not committed) calling `worked_answer` over every statement in `KY_TEST_BANK`, `KY_TEST_BANK_V0_5_2`, and the four-digit generator shape — expect `Some` only for `a + b = ?` / `a − b = ?` shapes (none of the 34 bank Mediums or graduate Hards parse; checked during planning). If any bank statement parses, that is fine (same arithmetic, same accuracy, still never the key) — record it, do not special-case it.

## Tests

Style follows `crates/ai/tests/ai/meditative_plus.rs` position tests (scenario → `decide` → assert the play) and the twin-key pattern in `ky_competition.rs`.

- `crates/ai/tests/ai/ky_competition.rs`, mod `r1563005_the_search_casts_the_competition_at_its_expected_kenny`:
  - `r1563005_the_ai_casts_the_competition_with_mana_and_no_better_play`: scenario seed `"r2929-cast"`, p1 hand `[meditativeplus-020, core-008]`, mana 2, p2 hand `[core-005]`; `decide` returns `Play` of the Competition instance (a 6/6 Kenny for (2) beats the (1) 4/4 vanilla; pre-fix it is valued ~1/1 and loses).
  - `r1563005_the_simulated_run_is_worth_a_kenny_of_the_expected_streak` (both faces): play the Competition via testkit `act`, call `own_prompt_score` with `create_node_counter(AI_BUDGET.nodes, None)` and `Prices::NONE`, assert `Some`. Reference: from the same state answer the worked label's option `AI_KY_COMPETITION_EXPECTED_STREAK` (resp. radiant constant) times then `stop_answer`, assert Kenny X equals the constant, score with `line_score(..., NextSwing::Enemy, ...)`; assert simulated ≥ reference. Imports to add: `own_prompt_score`, `create_node_counter`, `Prices`, `NextSwing`, `line_score`, `stop_answer`.
  - `r465_the_simulated_run_reads_the_statement_never_the_key`: twin post-cast states differing only in `ANSWER_KEY` give equal `own_prompt_score`; mirror the existing `r1184002_r465` twin construction.
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/answer_key.rs`, mod `r465_the_ai_works_out_kys_tests_easy_problem`:
  - `r465_the_ai_answers_the_easy_problem_right_when_the_right_letter_is_not_first`: find the first `n` in `0..200` with seed format `"r2929-ky-test-easy-{n}"` where casting `classicplus-042` and answering `Easy` leaves an `Answer` prompt whose `answer_key_of` is not `"A"`; hard-code that seed. `decide` returns the right `Answer` (selection `vec![Mode{option: key}]`), reason `Prompt`, `nodes == 0`. Twin with a flipped key decides identically.
- Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-ai ky_competition`, `cargo test -p jackioh-ai answer_key`, then `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check`. (Gate floors and the M+ #20 / C+ #42 sweep rerun belong to CI/daily, not this change.)

## Done when

- [ ] AI with Competition in hand, mana, and no better play casts it.
- [ ] AI answers Test Easy right on a non-first-letter seed and never reads the key (twin test).
- [ ] Simulated cast value ≥ Kenny-of-expected-streak value, base and Radiant.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, fmt, clippy, and `spec check` green; existing garbled-prompt, accuracy-rate, and key tests untouched and passing.
- [ ] No file outside the table changed; no spec note added (no new ruling).

## Risks

- Overvalue: the sim assumes the expected run deterministically (no miss sampling) and Test Easy deterministically right (~15% over its true expectation). Accepted: the alternative — sampling inside `simulate` — needs an rng threaded through `simulate`/`search`/`reply`, churn the proposal rejects; the same-accuracy, same-never-Stop rule bounds the error. The re-key writes only the worked letter, so a custom prompt that happens to parse but means something else would be mis-simulated — no shipped prompt does (step 8 proves it).
- Radiant runs (13 steps) bypass `max_auto_answers` (8) via the separate `KY_COMPETITION_MAX` cap; each step still costs one node, so budgets stay bounded and deterministic.
- `reply.rs` is deliberately unchanged: mid-reply seat prompts keep `best_auto_answer`; Competition/Test sequences resolve inside the seat's own turn, which the reply never plans through.

## Open questions

- The maintainer's "an 8/8 in this case" was read as the hard-code steer (integer literals, no sampling), with 6/12 derived from the 0.85/0.93 accuracies. If a literal 8 was meant for the base face, it is a one-line change to `AI_KY_COMPETITION_EXPECTED_STREAK` with no structural effect — please confirm in review.

If `streak` is `Some(s)`, return the right-answer body while `s` is below the face's expected constant (`pending.resume.radiant` selects it, same expression as `decide.rs`), else return `stop_answer(state)`. Otherwise run the existing `best_auto_answer` path and increment `answered`. Rationale for the re-key, stated in one comment line: `answered_correctly` is false with no key, so without it every simulated right answer would grade wrong and end the run.
6. `crates/ai/src/search.rs`, `score_line` #1636 branch: same priority. When the pending prompt belongs to `seat`, try `worked_sim_answer` first (re-key the clone from its own selection exactly as in step 5, step with the equivalent single-answer call, bounded by a local `worked` counter capped at `KY_COMPETITION_MAX`); on `None` keep the existing `best_auto_answer` call and `answered` cap. ## Tests

Style follows `crates/ai/tests/ai/meditative_plus.rs` position tests (scenario → `decide` → assert the play) and the twin-key pattern in `ky_competition.rs`.

  - `r1563005_the_simulated_run_is_worth_a_kenny_of_the_expected_streak` (both faces): play the Competition via testkit `act`, call `own_prompt_score` with `create_node_counter(AI_BUDGET.nodes, None)` and `Prices::NONE`, assert `Some`. Imports to add: `own_prompt_score`, `create_node_counter`, `Prices`, `NextSwing`, `line_score`, `stop_answer`.
  - `r465_the_simulated_run_reads_the_statement_never_the_key`: twin post-cast states differing only in `ANSWER_KEY` give equal `own_prompt_score`; mirror the existing `r1184002_r465` twin construction.
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/answer_key.rs`, mod `r465_the_ai_works_out_kys_tests_easy_problem`:
  - `r465_the_ai_answers_the_easy_problem_right_when_the_right_letter_is_not_first`: find the first `n` in `0..200` with seed format `"r2929-ky-test-easy-{n}"` where casting `classicplus-042` and answering `Easy` leaves an `Answer` prompt whose `answer_key_of` is not `"A"`; hard-code that seed. `decide` returns the right `Answer` (selection `vec![Mode{option: key}]`), reason `Prompt`, `nodes == 0`. - [ ] No file outside the table changed; no spec note added (no new ruling).

## Risks

- Overvalue: the sim assumes the expected run deterministically (no miss sampling) and Test Easy deterministically right (~15% over its true expectation). Accepted: the alternative — sampling inside `simulate` — needs an rng threaded through `simulate`/`search`/`reply`, churn the proposal rejects; the same-accuracy, same-never-Stop rule bounds the error. The re-key writes only the worked letter, so a custom prompt that happens to parse but means something else would be mis-simulated — no shipped prompt does (step 8 proves it).
